welcome:
🎉 Welcome to the Official Lottery Platform!

Please select your preferred language to begin:
request_contact: 📱 To complete your registration, please share your verified phone number using the button below:
registration_complete:
✅ Registration successful, {name}!

You can now browse active lotteries and cut your numbers.
main_menu:
🎯 Main Menu

Please select an option below:
active_lotteries_title:
🎯 Currently Active Lottery Events:

Select an event to view prizes, ticket prices, and available numbers:
pick_range: Please select a number range block:
available_in_range:
Available tickets in range {start} - {end}:
(Tap any number to reserve for 15 minutes)
ticket_reserved:
⏳ *Ticket #{number} Reserved for You!*

• Event: *{title}*
• Ticket Price: *{price} ETB*
• Time Window: *15 Minutes*

💳 *Send Payment to:*
• Provider: *{provider}*
• Receiver Account / Phone: `{account}`
• Receiver Name: *{name}*

📸 *Important:* Please transfer the exact amount and send a screenshot of the payment receipt here before the 15-minute countdown expires!

_Note: You can only have 1 active ticket reserved at a time._
active_reservation_blocked:
⚠️ *Active Reservation Detected*

You already have Ticket #{number} reserved for *{title}*.

Please complete your payment for Ticket #{number} or wait for its 15-minute timer to expire before cutting another ticket.
number_unavailable: ❌ Number #{number} has just been taken by another user or is no longer available. Please select another number.
payment_received:
🔍 *Payment Screenshot Received!*

Extracting reference and verifying with bank/telebirr via Veritas Engine...
Please wait a moment.
payment_verified_issued:
🎉 *Payment Verified & Ticket #{number} Issued!*

• Event: *{title}*
• Amount Paid: *{amount} ETB*
• Transaction Reference: `{reference}`
• Ticket Number: *#{number}*

Your ticket has been officially registered! Good luck in the upcoming draw.

You can now cut another ticket if you wish!
payment_manual_review:
⏳ *Payment Queued for Staff Verification*

We received your payment receipt for Ticket #{number}, but automated verification flagged an issue:
_{reason}_

Don't worry! Your ticket remains safely locked for you while our admin staff inspects your receipt manually.
payment_duplicate:
❌ *Duplicate Reference Detected*

This payment reference (`{reference}`) has already been used for another ticket. Reuse of receipts is strictly prohibited.
no_tickets_yet: You haven't purchased any tickets yet. Tap Active Lotteries to get started!
